Definition: amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor
BiblicalUsage: This word is a wide mantle or cloak, and by extension the splendour it gives the one who wears it. Micah says the rich strip the robe from those passing by in peace, and Zechariah is told to throw the price of a betrayed shepherd, thirty pieces of silver, to the potter, calling it the goodly price they valued him at. The mantle stands for honour, and both verses show honour being stripped away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe true splendour is not a cloak men can strip off, because the honour God gives cannot be taken by thieves or traitors.
